card.title: The Third Detail Matters
card.instruction: Choose one arbitrary detail and treat it as the key that explains, controls, or prevents the entire impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't press the kettle's third button. That tiny scratch on it is keeping the moon lit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the boil button. I want tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use a saucepan. We can't risk smoothing the scratch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll press it with my fingernail, around the scratch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me guide your hand. Everyone reading by moonlight is relying on this cup.

mechanism: A assigns the moon's light to one kettle scratch and controls ordinary tea-making to preserve that mark.
confusable: Unlike generalized fear of the impossible, A must make the single arbitrary detail determine all handling decisions.
comparison: The scratch alternative negotiates a precise touch around the mark; the pebble alternative creates a level support under the supposed stabilizer.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
